_what_this_is: The shape of the private library_questions.json the cluster half of the WP7 measurement reads. The REAL file lives in the truth folder (gitignored) and names the corpus ids; the five questions here are synthetic, against the synthetic library that report_ingest/tests/library_fixtures.py builds, and are committed only so the shape is readable without the corpus.
_how_it_is_scored: Each question goes to the report_library sub-agent. The answer's citations[] carry the report ids it actually cited and the pages behind them; the score is precision and recall of those report ids against 'reports' below, plus how often a question whose answer is not in the library was answered with a gap rather than with prose. 'pages' is optional and scored only where it is given.

_conventions.reports: every report id a correct answer must cite; an empty list means the library does not hold the answer and the right answer says so
_conventions.pages: optional [report, page] pairs a correct answer must cite; 0-based PDF pages, the same numbering the records use
_conventions.must_say_no: true where the question is deliberately unanswerable from the library

questions.question: Which reports in the library were written for the Vale Harbour post?
questions.note: a filter question; list_reports(post=...) answers it, and the report bound inside L02 belongs to the same post

questions.question: Which of these sites was called potentially liquefiable, and on what page does the report say so?
questions.note: a compare question with a page the answer must cite

questions.question: Which report and page prints an allowable bearing pressure of 3,000 psf?
questions.note: a where_is question; the retrieval also hits a second report that recommends spread footings, so the answer has to pick the one that prints the number

questions.question: Who wrote the earlier study bound inside the Harbour Gate report, and which pages of that report did it occupy?
questions.note: a bound document is its own report of the library; the answer must name it as such rather than crediting its boring to the parent

questions.question: What pile driving records does the library hold for the Larkspur Ridge parcel?
questions.note: the library holds no pile driving record for any report; the right answer says the library does not hold it and does not describe what such a record usually contains
